_about: Warnings shown at the top of earlier releases' notes. The release workflow adds each one once (mindit_release.py notices); files and tags are never changed.

notices.text: > ⚠️ **Don't install this release's Galaxy Tab app (APK).** It installs under the name "application" and closes at once — a packaging fault in builds 129–134. Use **[build 135 or newer](https://github.com/Coolrishi20/MindIt-Downloads/releases/latest)**: it installs over it with **Update** and keeps the tablet's data. The other files in this release are not affected.
